issues.item: Negative Appraisals: Contamination: I feel dirty or contaminated because of what happened
issues.explanation: The contamination appraisal is hard to reconcile with the rest of the profile for a terrorism trauma. The triggers, threat, and memory items all suggest a classic external-danger / sensory-cue pattern (fire, shouting, temperature, auditory reliving, hypervigilance), whereas feeling dirty or contaminated is more characteristic of interpersonal violation or moral contamination themes and is not supported elsewhere in this profile.

issues.item: Maladaptive Strategies: Never Alone: make sure never to be alone with another person
issues.explanation: 'Never alone with another person' is difficult to fit with the rest of the profile. As written, it implies avoiding being alone specifically with another person, which usually points to fear of interpersonal assault. That is not reflected in the terrorism-linked triggers, threat items, or memory content, and it does not align well with the selected negative appraisals. It appears to address a different threat context than the rest of the profile.

issues.item: Negative Appraisals: Contamination: I feel dirty or contaminated because of what happened
issues.explanation: 'Contamination/dirty' is much more characteristic of interpersonal/sexual trauma and is hard to reconcile as a central appraisal in an otherwise terrorism profile featuring fire, shouting, alarm, and fragmented sensory memory. With the rest of this profile, it stands out as trauma-type incongruent rather than merely unusual.

issues.item: Maladaptive Strategies: Never Alone: make sure never to be alone with another person
issues.explanation: 'Never alone with another person' implies fear of being harmed in one-on-one interpersonal contact, which does not fit the rest of the profile or the terrorism trauma context. The other strategies reflect generalized PTSD coping (avoid stressors, emotional numbing), but this item points to a distinct interpersonal threat pattern not supported by the triggers, threat, or memory items.
